<!doctype html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#071727">
<title>Дочь двух миров — Песнь прилива</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--paper:#f6ecdf;--muted:#c2d2dd;--line:#b9d9e15c;--gold:#e9c894;--gold2:#ae8956;--blue:#86dedb;--fontSize:17px;--motion:.45s}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;background:#020c16;color:var(--paper);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}button,input{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e6cf90;outline-offset:2px}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
#shell{width:100%;max-width:540px;height:100vh;height:100dvh;position:relative;margin:auto;overflow:hidden;background:#081e31;box-shadow:0 12px 80px #000e}
#sceneArt{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 22%,#174c68,#061827 63%,#050d19);pointer-events:none}
.art-fill{position:absolute;inset:-3%;width:106%;height:106%;object-fit:cover;filter:blur(23px) brightness(.65) saturate(1.05);transform:scale(1.04);opacity:.96}
.art-main{position:absolute;left:0;top:3.5%;width:100%;height:78%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 43%;filter:drop-shadow(0 15px 28px #03121d44);animation:artArrival .65s ease both}
#sceneArt:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,8,14,.58),transparent 16%,transparent 48%,rgba(3,15,25,.78) 77%,#061724 97%);pointer-events:none}
#glow{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,#bffaff65 0 1.5px, transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 10%,#e8ffff51 0 1.5px, transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 58%,#e8ffff45 0 2px, transparent 2.8px);background-size:138px 192px,226px 218px,198px 145px;animation:float 18s linear infinite;opacity:.65}
@keyframes float{to{transform:translateY(-80px)}}@keyframes artArrival{from{opacity:.4;transform:scale(1.045)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
#statusTop{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:3;padding:calc(13px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 15px 0;display:none;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#041827a8,transparent)}
#statusTop.active{display:flex}#topTitle{min-width:0;padding-top:3px}#partLabel{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:750}#placeLabel{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:16px;margin-top:4px;text-shadow:0 1px 10px #000}
.icon-row{display:flex;gap:6px}.iconbtn{border:1px solid #e8d7ac6e;border-radius:50%;background:#09253ccc;color:#fff0d4;min-width:39px;width:39px;height:39px;display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);font-size:17px}
#game{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2}#game.active{display:block}
#dialogueBox{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:3;min-height:225px;max-height:59%;padding:23px 19px calc(17px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));border-top:1px solid #f3d7a28f;background:linear-gradient(157deg,#081f35ec,#081624fb 85%);box-shadow:0 -15px 70px #0008;border-radius:26px 26px 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
#dialogueBox:before{content:"✦";position:absolute;left:50%;top:-16px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:20px;color:#ead7a3;text-shadow:0 0 17px #f2cf90;background:#0b2539;border:1px solid #d8b9829a;border-radius:50%;height:31px;width:31px;text-align:center;line-height:28px}
#speaker{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;color:#f6d59a;font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;min-height:25px}#lineText{font-size:var(--fontSize);line-height:1.56;color:#f0eff0;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-y:auto;max-height:22vh;min-height:70px;flex:1;animation:appear .35s ease both;scrollbar-width:thin}
#choices{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;max-height:29vh;padding:2px 0 4px}#choices.active{display:flex}.choice{color:#f6f0e5;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c5366e6,#153547e8);border:1px solid #bed7cd86;border-radius:12px;text-align:left;padding:12px 15px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;min-height:47px;transition:background .15s}.choice:active{background:#377c8f}.choice.special{border-color:#e5c994c2;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#735547b0,#27405aba)}
#nameEntry{display:none;margin:0 0 4px}#nameEntry.active{display:block}#nameEntry input{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddc89694;background:#0a2e43;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;font-size:16px}
#nextRow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:1px}.smallbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:#bacfcd;font-size:12px;padding:9px 4px;min-height:36px}.continue{border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#d6bd8e,#f2dcad);color:#153043;border:1px solid #ffe8b8;padding:10px 15px;min-width:119px;font-size:13px;font-weight:750}.continue:active{filter:brightness(.9)}#progressLabel{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.035em;color:#9db4c2;text-align:center;min-height:16px}
#cover{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;padding:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 25px calc(42px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#020b1a1b 0%,transparent 28%,#06132480 53%,#061422f2 78%,#061422 100%)}#cover.hidden{display:none}
#cover h1{font:italic 500 clamp(41px,10vw,57px)/.94 Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;margin:0 0 12px;text-shadow:0 4px 27px #000c;color:#f2dfb3}#cover .under{font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:11px;color:#f1dbb2;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 20px}#cover .tagline{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#e0e8ea;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:325px}#cover button{width:100%;min-height:50px;border-radius:10px;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid #d6bc84;color:#173348;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2dfb9,#d7b679);font-weight:750;font-size:13px}#cover button.alt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#17384bbf,#08263aca);color:#f3e4cc;border-color:#d6bc8475}#cover .version{margin-top:13px;color:#9fb7bc;font-size:10px}
#overlay{position:absolute;z-index:10;inset:0;background:#020e1ac9;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:12px;backdrop-filter:blur(13px)}#overlay.active{display:flex}#modal{width:100%;max-height:91%;overflow-y:auto;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#102d42,#061927);border:1px solid #dcc3977a;border-radius:22px;padding:20px 18px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-shadow:0 25px 100px #000c;scrollbar-width:thin}
.modal-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.modal-header h2{margin:0 0 12px;font:normal 27px Georgia,serif;color:#f5dfb4}.close{border-radius:50%;width:37px;height:37px;flex:none;background:#072b42;border:1px solid #d8bb8c96;color:#f3e9e0;font-size:22px}.section-intro{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#c6d6df;margin:0 0 16px}.entry{padding:13px 12px;border:1px solid #e0d2b03e;background:#ffffff0a;border-radius:11px;margin-bottom:9px}.entry small{font-size:10px;color:#e3c896}.entry b{display:block;color:#fff3d5;font:normal 16px Georgia,serif;margin:4px 0}.entry p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#cbdbdf;margin:5px 0 0}.modalbtn{width:100%;padding:12px;color:#fff5e8;background:#15425b;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #bfccba86;margin:6px 0;font-size:13px}.gallery-img{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:55vh;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid #e5cb969e;border-radius:12px;margin:10px 0;display:block;background:#092537}.muted{font-size:11px;color:#aac1ca}.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.gallery-card{background:#102f41;border:1px solid #d7bd8c66;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;color:#edebdf;padding:0}.gallery-card img{width:100%;height:154px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block}.gallery-card span{display:block;font-size:11px;padding:9px}.gallery-card.locked{opacity:.42}.toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 0;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff27}.toggle label{font-size:13px;color:#edebdf}.toggle input{accent-color:#e5c38e;width:18px;height:18px}.reading-line{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff20}.reading-line b{font-size:11px;color:#e4c78e}#finalAction{display:none}
@media (max-width:379px){#dialogueBox{padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px;max-height:61%}#lineText{font-size:calc(var(--fontSize) - 1px)}#speaker{font-size:19px}.choice{padding:10px 12px}#cover h1{font-size:41px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){:root{--motion:0s}#glow,.art-main{animation:none}}
body.reduce-motion #glow,body.reduce-motion .art-main,body.reduce-motion #lineText{animation:none!important}


/* Version 0.6: brighter artwork, restrained dialogue window, independent expression portraits. */
#sceneArt{background:#061a30}
.art-fill{filter:blur(18px) brightness(.84) saturate(1.13);opacity:.92}
.art-main{top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:86%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 38%;filter:none;animation:artArrival .7s ease both}
#sceneArt:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#07132265 0%,transparent 17%,transparent 47%,#05132128 62%,#061321d6 85%,#061724 100%)}
#sceneArt.pan-right .art-main{object-position:63% 38%}
#sceneArt.pan-left .art-main{object-position:39% 38%}
#sceneArt.collapse:before{content:' ';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 14% 7%,#f2e9e44d 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 71% 12%,#fff3d350 0 1px,transparent 2px),linear-gradient(140deg,transparent 45%,#cde7f027 46%,transparent 48%);background-size:91px 127px,136px 94px,100% 100%;animation:falling 5s linear infinite}
@keyframes falling{from{background-position:0 -130px,0 -130px,0 0}to{background-position:0 250px,0 250px,0 0}}
#dialogueBox{min-height:190px;max-height:min(52dvh,450px);padding:14px 15px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:6px;border-radius:22px 22px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(165deg,rgba(7,29,48,.91),rgba(4,20,35,.94) 90%);box-shadow:0 -6px 35px #0005}
#dialogueBox:before{height:20px;width:20px;line-height:18px;top:-11px;font-size:14px}
#speakerLine{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-height:49px}
#speakerText{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}
#speaker{font-size:19px;min-height:0}
#emotionLabel{font-size:10px;color:#a6c4ca;letter-spacing:.03em}
#portraitFrame{width:52px;height:52px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #ead0a0;box-shadow:0 0 14px #70d8e433;overflow:hidden;background:#082336;animation:appear .25s ease-out}
#portraitFrame img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
#portraitFrame.hidden{display:none}
#lineText{min-height:56px;max-height:19dvh;line-height:1.51}
#choices{max-height:29dvh;gap:7px}
.choice{min-height:42px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;background:#103b54ef}
#nextRow{margin-top:0}
#progressLabel{font-size:10px}
#statusTop{padding:calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 10px 0}
.icon-row{gap:4px}.iconbtn{min-width:35px;width:35px;height:35px;font-size:15px}
.slot-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:5px}.slot-actions .modalbtn{margin:2px 0;min-height:38px;padding:8px}
.slot-actions .danger{background:#4a2536;border-color:#a75c61}
@media(max-height:700px){#dialogueBox{max-height:64dvh}#lineText{min-height:43px;max-height:15dvh}#portraitFrame{height:44px;width:44px}.choice{min-height:38px}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="shell">
  <div id="sceneArt" aria-hidden="true"></div><div id="glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div id="statusTop"><div id="topTitle"><span id="partLabel">Глава I</span><span id="placeLabel">Жемчужный дворец</span></div><div class="icon-row"><button id="saveQuickBtn" class="iconbtn" aria-label="Сохранения">◈</button><button id="galleryBtn" class="iconbtn" aria-label="Галерея">▧</button><button id="historyBtn" class="iconbtn" aria-label="История диалогов">☷</button><button id="menuBtn" class="iconbtn" aria-label="Меню">⚙</button></div></div>
  <div id="game">
    <div id="dialogueBox" aria-live="polite"><div id="speakerLine"><div id="portraitFrame" class="hidden"><img id="portraitImg" alt="Портрет персонажа"></div><div id="speakerText"><div id="speaker"></div><span id="emotionLabel"></span></div></div><div id="lineText"></div><div id="nameEntry"><label class="muted" for="heroName">Имя героини (художественный облик Селены фиксирован)</label><input id="heroName" maxlength="24" value="Селена" autocomplete="off"></div><div id="choices"></div><div id="nextRow"><button id="prevBtn" class="smallbtn">‹ Назад</button><button id="nextBtn" class="continue">Далее ›</button></div><div id="progressLabel"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div id="cover"><h1>Дочь<br>двух миров</h1><p class="under">Глава первая · Песнь прилива</p><p class="tagline">Кинематографичная история о русалке, тайне древнего договора и решениях, которые невозможно отменить.</p><button id="continueBtn" class="alt" hidden>Продолжить</button><button id="newBtn">Новая история</button><button id="coverGalleryBtn" class="alt">Иллюстрации</button><div class="version">Иллюстрированное издание · 0.6 · Без интернета</div></div>
  <div id="overlay"><div id="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"></div></div>
</div>
